links.outcome: Readability (Flesch Reading Ease and Flesch-Kincaid grade level) of chatbot answers to vasectomy questions
links.effect: All five chatbots had mean FRES below 50 and above 10th-grade level. ChatGPT was hardest to read (FRES 30.4, FKGL 14.2); Bard was easiest (FRES 49.67, FKGL 10.1).
links.quote: In terms of readability, all five AI chatbots on average had Flesch Reading Ease scores of less than 50 and were higher than a 10th-grade level.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates five commercial LLM chatbots on accuracy and readability when answering vasectomy-related questions for patients, but it only benchmarks model performance without testing specific deployment safeguards or practices.
